truth_boundary: This ledger records current official-source facts checked for MoveFuel. It does not itself prove end-to-end image-to-calorie accuracy.

sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service
sources.version_or_status: Foundation 2026-04; FNDDS 2021-2023 (2024-10); SR Legacy 2018-04; Branded bulk 2026-04 with monthly updates through FDC v15.3 on 2026-07-23
sources.notes: Use Foundation/FNDDS for generic foods; exact branded/package records may use the live API so monthly branded changes newer than the April bulk release are not missed. Missing nutrients remain unknown. Preserve data type, FDC ID and publication/modified dates.

sources.license: FAO database terms / page-specific metadata must govern
sources.notes: Scientifically useful for volume-to-weight validation. Do not ship copied FAO data as a production commercial database until counsel confirms the exact dataset terms; FAO database terms contain a restriction concerning promotion of commercial enterprises/products.

sources.license: FAO database terms / page-specific metadata must govern
sources.notes: Reference/cross-check source only until exact rights and record applicability are reviewed.

sources.version_or_status: Public archived dataset; repository archived 2026-04-19; 5,006 plates; 181.4 GB full archive
sources.notes: Benchmark only, not nutrition runtime authority. Official README provides ingredient mass, dish mass/calories/macros, RGB-D where available, official train/test split, and cuisine-bias warning. Acquisition supports public GCS HTTPS directly; gsutil is optional. Audit detects malformed/plate-only/missing records rather than silently trusting them.

sources.version_or_status: FoodSeg103 benchmark; 7,118 images; 104 ingredient classes; pixel-wise masks
sources.license: Repository states Apache-2.0; dataset/image/third-party asset rights must be audited separately
sources.notes: Use as a benchmark/training candidate only after exact dataset and pretrained-weight rights are reviewed. A repository license is not automatically proof that every image/weight is commercially cleared.

sources.license: Small model weights Apache-2.0; Base/Large/Giant CC-BY-NC-4.0
sources.notes: Pin Small only for a commercial candidate. Raw relative depth is never centimeters; physical scale/calibration is required. Record exact checkpoint SHA-256. Open upstream discussion shows residual questions about training-data provenance, so final commercial review should retain that note. Runtime use remains candidate-only until final commercial provenance review closes.

Image input and structured outputs supported. Stable REST Interactions endpoint is /v1/interactions with x-goog-api-key; May 2026 schema uses steps and response_format. Gemini may return candidate identities/preparations and clarification, but production MoveFuel rejects model-supplied grams/calories/macros as authoritative.

sources.publisher: Government of Nepal, Department of Food Technology and Quality Control, National Nutrition Program
sources.version_or_status: Nepalese Food Composition Table 2017; FAO directory screening score 35/120
sources.notes: FAO explicitly says directory inclusion is not endorsement and recommends its evaluation framework. Keep as regional reference until quality/rights review is complete.

sources.publisher: Nepal Government, Department of Food Technology and Quality Control, National Nutrition Program
sources.notes: Cross-check regional values; do not outrank reviewed newer evidence solely on name match.

sources.publisher: Government of Nepal, Ministry of Agriculture
National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine
sources.notes: Adult and adolescent EER equations, PAL categories, prediction error, and monitor-weight-then-adjust planning principle are the science basis.
Adult carbohydrate 45-65% energy, fat 20-35%, protein 10-35%; use as review guardrails rather than a personalized prescription.
Current page states a protein target of 1.2-1.6 g/kg/day. MoveFuel keeps this a general-wellness band, not an elite-athlete or medical prescription.

sources.publisher: British Journal of Sports Medicine / PubMed record
sources.license: Article copyright; do not redistribute full text
sources.notes: Average fat-free-mass benefit plateau reported around 1.62 g/kg/day during resistance training; supports a 1.6 g/kg central general muscle-building target without claiming individual optimum.

sources.publisher: U.S. National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases
sources.version_or_status: Current public Body Weight Planner reference
sources.notes: Supports dynamic planning/recalibration and has a 1000 kcal/day lower safety warning in its tool. MoveFuel remains non-medical and should not silently copy the NIDDK model without licensing/implementation review.
